notes: Read all 281 source lines line by line before editing. L1-13 file-header doc is carried over and extended with a native-adaptations note. L15-26 web imports are each replaced: React hooks kept (useCallback/useEffect/useMemo/useRef/useState; web's `type KeyboardEvent` dropped as DOM-only); L22 react-i18next useTranslation -> local useNativeTranslationFallback; L23 `@/lib/cn` dropped (native uses StyleSheet); L24-25 `Icon`/`Icons.close` -> native SemanticIcon 'close' glyph via getSemanticIconDefinition; L26 `@/components/a11y` VisuallyHidden -> native '../a11y' VisuallyHidden.

Preserved the public API exactly: FilterChipDescriptor (L36-41: key/label/value/onRemove) and ActiveFilterChipsProps (L43-59: filters/onClearAll/className/hideWhenEmpty=true/maxVisible=8). className is accepted but intentionally ignored on native (aliased to _className) since native styles via tokens.

Preserved state and refs: removalAnnouncement (L74), overflowOpen (L75), announceCounterRef (L81). web's overflowRef (L76, DOM ref) is dropped because the outside-click effect is replaced by a native Modal.

L61 POPOVER_DISMISS_KEYS + L84-100 DOM outside-click/Escape useEffect have no DOM equivalent on native; the overflow popover is rendered in a React Native Modal whose backdrop Pressable (outside-press) and onRequestClose (hardware back) collapse it, preserving the dismiss-on-outside-interaction and dismiss-on-escape intent.

L103-105 collapse-overflow-when-filters-empty useEffect is preserved verbatim. L107-121 visible/overflow useMemo (maxVisible<=0, filters.length<=maxVisible, and reserve-one-slot branches) is ported field-for-field. L123-126 hideWhenEmpty+isEmpty early null return preserved.

L128-150 announceRemoval/handleRemove/handleClearAll preserved including the `\u200B`.repeat(counter % 4) zero-width padding trick that forces assistive tech to re-announce; on native the changed string drives accessibilityLiveRegion via VisuallyHidden liveRegion (L235 -> native VisuallyHidden liveRegion). L152-160 handleChipKey (Backspace/Delete) is a web-only keyboard shortcut with no touch-native equivalent and is dropped; chip removal stays available through the close button.

L162-237 render: outer div(role=group, aria-label, data-testid) -> View(accessibilityLabel=t('filters.activeLabel'), testID='active-filter-chips'); visible.map -> Chip; L178-218 overflow '+N more' button+popover -> Pressable trigger (accessibilityState expanded, aria-haspopup intent) + Modal menu(accessibilityRole='menu', label t('filters.moreLabel')); the L207-210 'close popover when removing the last overflow chip' branch is preserved; L220-232 Clear-all -> Pressable. All Tailwind class strings (gap-2, rounded-full, border, px/py, var(--surface/border/text) colors, focus rings) are mapped to StyleSheet tokens (colors/spacing/shadows); neon/hover states become pressed styles.

L240-281 Chip: ChipProps keeps descriptor/onRemove/fullWidth; onKey is dropped with handleChipKey. removeLabel uses t('filters.removeAria','Remove filter {{label}}',{label}). Web span(truncate)+label/value spans -> nested AppText with numberOfLines={1}, tone muted (label) + tone primary semibold (value). Web close button (Icon Icons.close, size xs, aria-label) -> Pressable(accessibilityRole='button', accessibilityLabel=removeLabel, hitSlop for touch-target-overlay) rendering the SemanticIcon 'close' glyph as text.

i18n intent preserved with original keys + English fallbacks and {{label}}/{{count}} interpolation: filters.removed, filters.clearedAll, filters.activeLabel, filters.moreCount, filters.moreLabel, filters.removeAria, filters.clearAll. No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components are imported; only React, React Native primitives (View/Pressable/Modal/StyleSheet), and existing native components/tokens.
Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit), npm run lint -- --quiet (eslint), npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles (jest) — all green.
